canvas_scope: one episode per Canvas (DramaClaw donor precedent: FreezoneCanvasScope episode/beat/asset)
graph_generator: deterministic seeded generator: episode-shaped graphs (beat to frame to clip chains in storyboard groups, plus notes and asset reference nodes), seed 20260929, edges = round(1.5 x nodes)

measurement.continuous: frame time from requestAnimationFrame deltas during scripted pan, zoom and node drag at zoom 0.5 and 1.0
measurement.discrete: input event to the next painted frame after the store commit (performance.mark/measure around the handler plus rAF), per operation
measurement.open: navigation start of the Canvas route to the first frame with all visible nodes mounted and input enabled
measurement.heap: performance.measureUserAgentSpecificMemory where available, else CDP HeapProfiler after GC; Canvas-attributable = Canvas route minus an empty route baseline
measurement.bundle: vite build manifest: initial chunk delta against the base commit, and the lazy Canvas chunk size, gzip

environment.browser: Chromium bundled with the repository Python Playwright 1.63, headless, production build (vite build + preview)
environment.machine: recorded in the result: CPU model, cores, RAM, GPU, OS, display refresh rate
environment.low_end_profile: 4x CPU throttling; must meet the discrete-operation threshold at the 100-node rung

repetitions: at least 30 per operation per rung, over 3 cold runs
statistics: p50 and p95 over all repetitions of an operation at a rung, nearest-rank
pass_rule: every rung and operation meets its threshold; any missing measurement is a failure
on_failure: blocks the React Flow adapter, not the M8-A exploration authority (spec section 7)
